title: Get to know Cashier
summary: Tour of Cashier, Miscellaneous Transactions, Product and Services Categories, Sessions and Physical Cash Registers: what each screen is for.

steps.title: Cash register
steps.details: This section has 5 screens; we'll go through them one by one.

steps.title: Cash register
steps.details: To take payments or record movements there has to be an open cash session. It's opened by counting the starting cash and closed by counting the final cash: the system compares what was counted with what was recorded (cash count) and leaves the closing report. It has 5 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Miscellaneous Transactions
steps.details: Small expenses (cleaning, stationery, shipping), cash withdrawals or contributions, with their category (which defines whether it's income or expense), payment method and receipt. They're recorded in the open cash session. It has 3 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Menu → Cashier → Product and Services Categories
Product and Services Categories
steps.details: They classify miscellaneous movements and define whether they're income or expense, so they come out organized in the reports. It has 2 guides in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Sessions
steps.details: Every opening and closing with who did it, cash register, counts, movements and reconciliation (system vs. declared) per payment method. It has 1 guide in «Guide me on this screen».

steps.title: Physical Cash Registers
steps.details: Each physical cash register (front desk, another branch) has its own opening and closing sessions and belongs to a branch. It has 2 guides in «Guide me on this screen».
